name: sketchpad
description: A phone-first piano sketchpad: keys, chords, scales, loops and short lessons played on the piano.

scripts.test: node tools/extract-theory.mjs sketchpad.jsx tests/theory.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.site: node tools/build-app.mjs && node tools/package-site.mjs build/sketchpad-app.html site/ dist/
